'''Logray''' was a great legendary warrior in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology. "Logray" was a popular name given to male Ewoks,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Logray/Legends|the shaman]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="SW6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Logray was first mentioned in the roleplaying game ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'' in [[2003]].<ref name="GCG" />
